collectr_world: Karel "Ash" World arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a letter he never sent and a borrowed coat two sizes too big. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Karel "Ash" World let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Karel "Ash" World found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: an old man with a dog, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
scottjseale: Gustav Scottjseale took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
